d: A heated dispute between police and lawyers that began at Shahdara police station in Delhi has come into focus after a lawyer from Karkardooma Court suffered a head injury when his nameplate was used to hit him, requiring eight stitches. In an exclusive conversation, the injured advocate shared the full account of what happened that day, accusing police personnel of standing by and allowing the assault while allegedly wanting the lawyers to be beaten.
